title: resource applied
description: A resource was created or updated. A before of null means it was created. A board open on the design shows the change without reloading the whole design.

source.description: /designer/<design>: the event comes from e-designer and names the design it serves, so a reader listening to many products knows which design changed (ADR-E2).

data.description: Which resource changed, in which file, and the file's hash before and after.

file.description: The file that holds the resource, relative to the design, so a reader knows which file to read again.

kind.description: The resource's kind, such as Block. An id is unique only within a kind, so kind and id together name the resource.

id.description: The resource's id; read together with kind.

before.description: sha256 of the file before; null when the file is new.
